load_ai2_arc_dataset: load the AI2 ARC Challenge dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method
extract_choices_and_answer: extract choices and answer strings from an AI2 ARC datapoint using get_choices_and_answer_string
map_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face dataset split to a list of question-answer tuples using map_hf_dataset_to_list
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, dev, and test splits from the AI2_ARC dataset using generate_k_shot_data
run_arc_preprocessing: run the main function to preprocess AI2 ARC data across multiple random seeds
